_comment: Golden reference for reconstruction-param parity with the EpiCycle monorepo. Mirrors packages/epicycle_reconstruction/config.py (gradient_descent block + pre_smooth defaults) as of 2026-06-12. tests/test_smoothing_parity.py asserts the standalone engine's effective params match these shared tuned values, so any future drift (in either repo, when re-synced) fails LOUDLY as a red test instead of silently on an HPC run. This is NOT a full param dump — only the deliberately-tuned values both repos must agree on.
